## Shared scenes

> While attending school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is taunted by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who calls her 'Carrots' and pulls her hair. Enraged, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head, leading Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) to punish her by making her stand at the blackboard. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proudly rejects Gilbert's attempt to apologize.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert with their classmates, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), unaware that Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is sleeping in it. The surprise causes [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) to react angrily, threatening to cut short her visit and cancel Diana's music lessons until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take responsibility.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), floating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) down the pond in a leaky boat. After the boat sinks, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clings to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her, though she refuses his offer of friendship. Back home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on learning not to be overly romantic, but [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently encourages her to keep a bit of romance in her life.
>

> As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return next year to prepare the class for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts away her books for the summer to enjoy her childhood, while Mrs. Lynde visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises Anne's remarkable growth and improvement over the past three years.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful, active summer outdoors on the [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) doctor's orders before returning to her studies in autumn. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) observes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) growing up into a quieter, taller young woman and privately grieves the passing of Anne's childhood.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who grows emotional reflecting on how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) means to them. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to her new living arrangements and classes, feeling a mix of rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and homesickness. Her spirits are lifted when [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit, bringing news that Queen's will award an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns from the oculist with news that her failing eyesight will force her to sell [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let her sell, giving up her college scholarship to stay home, teach, and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. Lynde later reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could teach close to home, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate the ethics and effectiveness of corporal punishment in school teaching on the eve of the school year. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxious about her upcoming first day of teaching.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as they drive through the countryside to canvass for hall repairs. They visit several local residents, dealing with the pessimistic Miss [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md), receiving a secret donation from Catherine, helping Dan Blair mix a cake, and navigating Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to gather subscriptions.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) residents, visiting Mrs. Theodore White and several other neighbors with varying degrees of success. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cleverly visits him while he is overjoyed and secures a five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he refuses.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) about their teaching experiences and future aspirations. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home tired and reveals that her sick relative [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) Keith cannot care for her twins much longer. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces a hesitant [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the Keith twins out of a sense of duty.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) debate Mrs. Lynde's virtues and discuss the village hall painting project. Later, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint numbers, causing dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite the hideous result, public sympathy turns in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the community rallies around them.
>

> Mrs. Lynde tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about preparations for the Ladies' [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar and asks to borrow Miss Barry's platter, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns Marilla's sight is improving. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle extending their stay, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted ads, prompting a committee of girls to try unsuccessfully to talk him out of it.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks to the graveyard, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as they share their feelings about memory, grief, and imagination. After placing flowers on the graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. Allan, and they walk home together while reflecting on teaching, ideals, life choices, and the value of friendship.
>

> After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to a sprained ankle. Sitting on the porch at twilight, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency toward high hopes and deep disappointments, how to replace Aunt Josephine's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea while his grandmother is away, reassuring him about his imaginative ideas. She returns home to handle [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before bedtime and then encounters [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).
>

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Improvement Society's progress and school developments. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.
>

> Uncle Abe's storm prediction comes true with violent force, bringing a devastating hail storm to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the twins rush home from school as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) suffers broken windows and stripped vegetation. The storm kills Mr. Harrison's parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) and ruins local crops and young trees, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) find solace in the fact that Mr. Boulter's unsightly old house burned down.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) chat about growing up and the upcoming changes before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to college. Later, while walking home from the post office, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) runs into [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who tries to express his romantic feelings, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) abruptly cuts the moment short. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before going off to dream by the brook.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

> The A.V.I.S. throws a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, though Anne's evening is somewhat ruined by Gilbert's sentimentality and Charlie Sloane's dull company. The next day, after dealing with discouraging goodbyes from local women, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a peaceful evening walk in the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), restoring her spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P38](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0038)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after tearful goodbyes and travels by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arriving, she is warmly greeted by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who whisks her away to their new boardinghouse and helps lift her homesick spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as the Freshmen win the annual rush led by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) into her social circle, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) confides her admiration for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a batch of letters from home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), including updates from Mrs. Lynde, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and Ruby, which reconnects her to her old life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Philippa, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for an autumn walk in the park and enjoy the sunset from a pavilion. On their way back along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), they admire a quaint little house called Patty's Place, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a strong connection to.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P24](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P30](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0030), [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)_

> During her term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deals with an unwelcome proposal from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). Later, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receive a letter from [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) suggesting they rent a house together next year with Stella's aunt as housekeeper. After a long, unsuccessful house hunt, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discover that Patty's Place is available to let.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) surprises [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by revealing she submitted Anne's story to a baking powder company's contest with added advertisement lines, and that it won the twenty-five dollar prize. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply humiliated and disgraced by the ad placement, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to comfort her with a practical perspective on the accomplishment.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P11](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.Down P15](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0015), [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022), [v3 ch.Down P35](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a snowbound [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday and finds Gilbert's visits increasingly uncomfortable. She worries about being able to afford her next year at college until she receives a letter announcing a thousand-dollar legacy from the late Miss Josephine Barry.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

_Sources: [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P21](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0021), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P30](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0030)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat at Patty's Place about summer plans and their housemates. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) then finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alone in the orchard and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving them both devastated, and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) later scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for refusing him.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P15](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0015), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P34](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0034), [v3 ch.Speaks P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048)_

> While dressing for a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) college reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seeing [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). The news secretly unsettled [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though she left for the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) and observed [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) with Christine across the room.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding, reminiscing about their childhood vows of friendship and future plans. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives to walk [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the parlor for the ceremony and then accompanies her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) afterwards, taking a moonlight stroll through Lovers' Lane.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as examinations end and graduation arrives. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's lilies instead of Roy's flowers, but she breaks Gilbert's necklace after hearing a rumor about his upcoming engagement. She acts blithely through the graduation dance, refusing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) a dance, and later unwinds with her roommates and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P39](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0039)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to invite her on a walk, which they postpone until the following day. When they walk to Hester Gray's garden, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) confesses his enduring love for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and asks her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gladly accepts, and they clear up past misunderstandings before walking home together engaged.
>
